name: logger
description: Structured leveled logger — JSON-line transport, child loggers, base fields, and pluggable redaction.
docs:
A dependency-free structured logger.

- `createLogger(options)` → `{ debug, info, warn, error, child }`. Each method takes a message and an optional context object.
- `level` gates output (`debug` < `info` < `warn` < `error`); default `info`.
- `transport` receives a `LogRecord` (`level`, `message`, `time`, `context`). The default `jsonConsoleTransport` writes one JSON line per record on the matching console method.
- `base` fields are merged into every record and inherited by `child(context)` loggers.
- `redact` rewrites context before it reaches the transport. Pair it with the `errors` package's `sanitize` to strip PII: `createLogger({ redact: (c) => sanitize(c) as Record<string, unknown> })`.
